description: Reonic provides software for renewable-energy installers to plan systems such as photovoltaics and heat pumps, generate offers, and manage customer projects and workflows. Its platform includes lead intake, project management, and configuration tools for residential and commercial energy projects.
summary: Reonic exposes one documented developer integration surface: a REST API at `https://api.reonic.de/rest/v3/`, authenticated with a Reonic-issued API key in the `X-Authorization` header. No public GraphQL API, MCP server, or CLI was found for `reonic.de`.
